summary: Adds evidence-backed, device-specific non-trace CMSIS-Pack Debug Description sequences to an existing Device Family Pack PDSC, keeps a private proposal record, applies the confirmed change, and reports validation results.
triggers: reliable debug through sleep, deep-sleep, and device low-power modes
verification: Run `$apply-confirmed-pdsc-proposal` with `$validate-pdsc-sequence-xml` as the common validation step
Compare every overridden predefined sequence against its current specification default
Perform documented low-power checks when a target is available
Set `APPLIED` only after all checks pass
stop_conditions: Stop when the knowledge record is inadequate, a required specification default is unavailable, confirmation is absent, or any validation fails.
Return insufficient access facts to `$debug-access-knowledge` and behavior facts to `$debug-knowledge`.
Present it with the proposed XML and obtain confirmation.
Do not modify `.dbgconf` without explicit confirmation.

rules.delta: reset, unlock, authentication, boot, flash, processor-control, low-power, register, delay, or connection behavior
unless authoritative inputs require it. Identify each required dependency in the output.
